name: research
description: Evidence-grounded web research: bundles the Research Powerpack MCP with ask, deep, verify and doctor skills and hooks that keep a quote ledger outside the context window.

interface.shortDescription: Cited web research with verbatim quotes
interface.longDescription: Answers, deep research runs and fact-checks where every claim points at a verbatim quote the server pulled from the page. A quote ledger lives on disk, and hooks flag unknown ids, uncited numbers and numbers the cited quote does not state.
defaultPrompt: Research whether library X supports Y and cite the exact lines
